comparison_and_noninheritance.difference: F1 is gravity-driven flow around a suspended obstacle; this route has no suspended obstacle and instead transfers an initially stationary reservoir over an internal crest.

The historical q=.75 case changes rotating-cup duration and has a hard-pass but event-censored execution. This route has no rotating cup, no duration parameter, no prior horizon extension and a new reservoir/crest/receiver topology.
The static full-cup scope starts with a filled cup and holds it; this route starts with a continuous upstream reservoir and has a separate internal crest and downstream receiver.
mDBC is retained only as a native boundary implementation reference; no H2 result, case identity or qualification credit is imported.
F5 is an external wave/runup measurement probe with wave source and gauge semantics; this route has no wave maker, runup gauge or external wave reference.

lineage_decision: This is a fresh F2 physical and boundary/topology hypothesis. Prior F1 hard failure and F2 dynamic event-censored execution remain preserved evidence and are not retried, relabeled or merged into this scope.
